mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Step through the program stopped in the debugger.

description: [read-only] Moves the stopped debuggee: each call sends one SAP request, the operation's. kind abap, on the attached debuggee: stepInto, stepOver, stepReturn and stepContinue step from where it stands; stepRunToLine runs to the line object_type, object_name and line name, stepJumpToLine moves there and skips what lies between; a step answers SAP's step result, or ended when SAP reports the program's end, and the stopped position is read from the stack. setStackPosition makes frame position the one variables are read in. kind amdp: stepOver and stepContinue move debuggee_id and answer the request id; the next stop arrives as a break event. Runs outside batch mode.

debuggee_id.description: amdp: the debuggee id of the break event.

detail.description: How much of the answer to return: "terse" (default, the fields you need to act), "full" (the whole parse), "raw" (the document as ADT sent it).

include.description: For a class: definitions, implementations, macros or testclasses; the main source when omitted.

kind.description: abap works with the ABAP debugger; amdp with the AMDP debugger of SQLScript methods.

line.description: For a line: the line in the object source.

object_name.description: For a line: the object holding it.

object_type.description: For a line: CLAS, PROG, INCL or FUNC.

operation.description: The one request: abap stepInto, stepOver, stepReturn, stepContinue, stepRunToLine, stepJumpToLine or setStackPosition; amdp stepOver or stepContinue.

parent_name.description: For a function module: its function group.

position.description: abap setStackPosition: the frame's position in the stack.

state_handle.description: Opaque handle identifying the server-held state this operation works on.

name: HandlerDebugStep
